import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Columns as per target schema and source schemas (all identical)
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target columns (source columns match target columns)
        df = df[target_columns]
        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target,
    # we can concatenate (union) them directly
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Enforce data types as per target schema:
    # 'tripduration': integer
    combined_df['tripduration'] = combined_df['tripduration'].astype(int)

    # 'starttime' and 'stoptime': string (keep as string, but ensure no NaN)
    combined_df['starttime'] = combined_df['starttime'].astype(str)
    combined_df['stoptime'] = combined_df['stoptime'].astype(str)

    # 'start station id', 'end station id', 'bikeid', 'birth year', 'gender': integer
    int_columns = ['start station id', 'end station id', 'bikeid', 'birth year', 'gender']
    for col in int_columns:
        # Some birth year or gender might have missing or invalid values, coerce errors then fillna with 0 or -1 if needed
        combined_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # 'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station latitude', 'end station longitude': float
    float_columns = ['start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station latitude', 'end station longitude']
    for col in float_columns:
        combined_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df[col], errors='coerce').astype(float)

    # 'usertype': string (keep as string)
    combined_df['usertype'] = combined_df['usertype'].astype(str)

    # Save the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
